items.title: 61125_Teddy Bunn oral history interview
items.q: I told you that much I knew right now.

ctx.x: I was going to play some other recordings, but I was wondering if there was anything else you had to say about Hot Lips Page, or anything you remember about him.
Well, not too much now. I told you that much I knew right now.

items.title: 61125_Teddy Bunn oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. You met him in New York.

ctx.x: Where was he from? Do you know?
No, I didn't know where Hot Lips he was from; unless I guess he was from down south somewhere.
Yeah. You met him in New York.
